body.statement: For disjoint \(L,T\) with \(|L|\le k\), \(1\le|T|\le k\), and \(|L\cup T|\le2k\), \[\Delta(L,T)=2\sqrt{r_0(L)r_1(L)}\,g(u_0,u_1)=\sqrt{r_0(L)r_1(L)}\,\|z(u_0)-z(u_1)\|_2^2.\] Moreover \(mI\preceq H\preceq MI\), \(H^{1/2}\operatorname{diag}(H)^{-1}H^{1/2}\succeq(m/M)I\), and \(\|u_a\|_2^2\le1-s/V\) for both arms.
body.justification: The chordal identity isolates the exact two-arm geometry and the frame inequality retains coordinate meaning after residualization.
body.gap: Neither the fixed-set Gaussian formulas of Lin et al. nor the regression spectral proof of Das and Kempe derives this coupled upper-hemisphere information identity.
body.consumer: The identity turns a causal-bound selection problem into a geometric frame comparison that can be reused for certificates and diagnostics.
